connectsTitle: Connected to the rest of the business

connects.text: Every document is sent and shared from your own templates.
Conversations show on the customer's page.
The assistant writes minutes from your meetings.
A bill sent to a chat account is read and filed for you to confirm.

faq.q: Do customers need an account to join a meeting?
faq.a: No. Guests open the link, say their name and wait until a host lets them in. Members of your organisation come straight in.

faq.q: What happens if we reach our sending limit?
faq.a: Messages over the limit are held, never lost. Limits are set by your plan.

faq.q: Can the team see a customer's message and the invoice it is about together?
faq.a: Yes. Conversations are tied to records, so the message sits with the invoice, order or customer it concerns.
